scope: Fashion-led women's basketball merchandise and collaborations (WNBA), plus adjacent women's-sports examples (NWSL, club/retailer capsules) used to test whether patterns travel. A purposive, documented set — not a census.
_fields: actor = the independent unit counted by the evidence rubric. k: fact = stated by the source; price = a published price; claim = marketing or unaudited statement, never used as evidence.

launches.name: Dream × Monarch Commerce: Drip Shop and 'Homegrown' line
launches.available: On sale around the Rebel uniform release; exact on-sale date for the full line not stated
launches.collab: The team hands retail operations and curated product to a women's-sports-focused commerce company; the Dream is described as its first WNBA franchise client.
launches.audience: Fans who want to wear team product away from the arena

facts.t: Announced a new in-arena 'Drip Shop', an online shop and a new back-end model for distributing curated women's product, with Monarch Commerce.
The 'Homegrown' line includes everyday fan pieces, lounge sets, ties, scarves and bandana-style pieces, in-stadium exclusives and bags made from upcycled jerseys.
Rebel uniform: black base, peach accents, coast-blue details; Atlanta area codes woven into the fabric.
Crop tops named as a silhouette; Monarch staff described as former Nike executives; more Dream collections planned.
'Several firsts in the league', including a first licensed WNBA tie and first diamante (bedazzled) pieces.
Positioned as designed for women rather than men's merchandise resized.

gaps: No prices published in either source.
No fabric compositions beyond the upcycled bags.
No sales, sell-through or margin information.

launches.name: 'United We Dream': Dream × Atlanta United × Round21
launches.collab: Two clubs from different leagues share one three-piece capsule produced with a 'cultural sports product platform'.
launches.audience: Fans of both clubs; Women's History Month tie

facts.t: Three limited-edition pieces: premium fleece hoodie, lightweight mesh short-sleeve top, classic graphic tee, each with co-branded detailing.
Launched Thursday March 12, 2026 in Atlanta United's stores and online at MLSStore.com and ATLDreamShop.com.
Round21 is described as a 'cultural sports product platform'.

gaps: No prices published.
No indication of quantities or customer overlap between the two clubs.

launches.name: Playa Society × Dream × Cash App: statement court and streetwear
launches.available: Tied to the May 22, 2025 home opener

price.note: Range as stated in the announcement.

launches.collab: A streetwear label designs a merchandise line and a statement center-court graphic that also appears on practice jerseys.
channels: Select styles at the Dream store

fever.note: The Fever were the opponent at the debut game; no Fever product.

facts.t: 'First-of-its-kind WNBA statement court' reading 'Pay Some Respect to Women's Sports', debuting May 22, 2025; the slogan also appears on practice jerseys.
Streetwear collection with Playa Society and Cash App, priced $45 to $180.
Sold at playasociety.com and select styles at the Dream retail store.

gaps: Individual product list and prices per item not given.
No sales information.

launches.name: Nike Rebel Edition uniforms and Rebel Fanwear
launches.available: 2026-05-08 on nike.com, lockervision.wnba.com, team stores and select retailers
launches.collab: Uniform designs made with each team; fan apparel carries the uniforms' colors, graphics and 'spirit of self-expression'.

fever.note: The Indiana Fever are one of the 15 teams in the Rebel Edition.

facts.t: Victory Rebel Edition (jersey and shorts) designed with all 15 teams; sits alongside the existing Heroine (white) and Explorer (team color) editions.
Rebel Fanwear includes a hoodie, T-shirt and shorts taking design cues from the Rebel Edition's colors and graphics.
Nike says designs reflect each team's local influences and were built on insights from team communities.

gaps: No prices or materials in the release.
No indication which team designs sell best.

launches.name: Nike Caitlin 1: signature apparel range
launches.available: Oct 1, 2026 globally (Sept 24 in China); shoe colorways launched earlier

price.note: Adult pieces only: women's tee $47 to varsity jacket $325. Two kids' items ($35 tee, $75 hoodie) are excluded so the range is comparable with adult fan tees.

launches.collab: A single athlete's design language (cement-court graphics, CC logo, '2' motifs) carried across a shoe, 18 apparel pieces and kids' sizes.
launches.audience: Fans and players; adult and youth sizes

fever.note: Clark plays for the Fever. This is a Nike athlete line, not Fever team merchandise.

facts.t: Nike lists 18 apparel pieces: Aero-FIT performance pieces with a cement-inspired print, 'Standard Issue Stretch' pieces, jackets, graphic hoodies and T-shirts 'meant to work on and off the court'.
Standard Issue style comes to women hoopers 'for the first time' (Nike's wording).
Retail listing: tee $47; Dri-FIT hoodie $90; brushed hoodie $95; varsity jacket $325; woven jacket $200; long-sleeve tops $105; 6-inch shorts $70; kids' tee $35; kids' fleece hoodie $75.

gaps: Prices come from a retailer's release listing, not Nike's release.
No fabric compositions beyond technology names.
No sell-through data.

launches.name: adidas × Ryoko Rain (apparel) for All-Star 2026
launches.available: Online and select Dick's Sporting Goods stores
launches.collab: An outside label's apparel graphics and recurring butterfly motif around an 'invisible work' story.

fever.note: Fever's Sophie Cunningham has a player-exclusive shoe in a separate adidas pack (Crazy Energy Pack, July 24) — not part of Ryoko Rain.

facts.t: Ryoko Rain collection built around the 'invisible' work before accolades; apparel graphics and a recurring butterfly motif.
The athlete-specific shoes (Sabally, Cunningham) and an All-Star edition belong to a separate 'Crazy Energy Pack' dropping July 24, 2026.

gaps: Only one secondary source read; the adidas release was not opened in this review.
No silhouette list, prices or exact date.
Correction: v4 described the player shoes as part of this collaboration.

launches.name: Athleta × Golden State Valkyries: off-court apparel partner
launches.available: Online edit now; co-branded team-store merchandise 'beginning in 2027'
launches.collab: A women's performance-lifestyle brand becomes a team's official off-court apparel partner, with co-branded merchandise in the team store from 2027.
launches.audience: Fans who want everyday apparel; Bay Area girls' programming
launches.release_model: Multiyear; limited online edit now, co-branded line later

fever.note: A model for what a specialist apparel partner could look like at team level.

facts.t: Multiyear deal naming Athleta the Valkyries' Official Off-Court Apparel Partner.
'Off-Court Edit': limited-time performance lifestyle assortment modeled by Veronica Burton, on Athleta.com.
Sept 18 game: limited-edition T-shirts for 350 attendees; co-branded merchandise sold in the team store beginning in 2027.
Financial terms, merchandise volumes and performance targets were not disclosed.

gaps: No prices, no product list for the 2027 line.
v4's official link was not confirmable; the syndicated press release is used instead.

launches.name: Catbird: WNBA's first demi-fine jewelry partner
launches.collab: Official league jewelry partner; limited-edition 'Jumpwoman' logo-silhouette charm, engravable basketball charm and city-letter charm (eight team tricodes).
launches.audience: Fans seeking a personal, giftable keepsake
launches.release_model: Limited-edition collection tied to the 30th season

fever.note: City-letter charms use official team tricodes; whether the Fever is among the eight cities was not stated.

facts.t: Catbird named the WNBA's official jewelry partner, described as its first demi-fine jewelry partner.
Three charms: Jumpwoman (with a 30th-season mark), Engravable Basketball, City Letter (tricodes for eight cities).
Sterling silver and 10-karat solid gold; prices start at $74.
Campaign imagery features Liberty founding players Teresa Weatherspoon and Sue Wicks.

gaps: Starting price only.
Which eight cities not stated.
No sales information; deal length and terms not disclosed.

launches.name: Coach × WNBA: partnership, then a $95 basketball bag charm
launches.available: Bag charm listed at coach.com (checked 2026-11-19); release date not stated
launches.collab: A luxury accessories brand is the league's handbag partner; 18 months after the announcement a limited product appeared.

fever.note: The 2025 announcement also named Coach presenting partner of the 2025 All-Star Game in Indianapolis.

facts.t: Multiyear partnership naming Coach the league's official handbag partner (April 14, 2025). The release announced no product.
'Coach | WNBA Basketball Bag Charm' is a limited-edition basketball-shaped charm at $95, marking the WNBA's 30th anniversary.

gaps: Single product; no broader Coach × WNBA collection found.
Release date and quantity not stated.

launches.name: Off Season × WNBA: designer-led fanwear
launches.available: 2025-09-04; still listed at the WNBA Store on 2026-11-19

price.note: Corset regular price $125 at the WNBA Store (listing).

launches.collab: A designer brand known for reworked licensed outerwear makes women's and unisex WNBA pieces for four launch teams.
launches.release_model: Ongoing collection, four teams at launch

fever.note: The Fever are one of the four launch teams.

facts.t: Debut centered on four teams: Golden State Valkyries, Indiana Fever, Las Vegas Aces, New York Liberty; women's and unisex styles.
Prices from $110 to $185; sold via the Off Season site, WNBA Store and Fanatics sites.
The WNBA Store lists a 'Women's Golden State Valkyries Off Season x WNBA Violet Fleece Corset' at $125 regular.

gaps: Cropped button-up and cargo shorts (in v4) were not confirmed by any source read; removed.
Product list beyond the corset not verified.
No sales information.

launches.actor: New York Liberty / New York or Nowhere

facts.t: Seven co-branded pieces: two hoodies, two varsity jackets, sweatpants, a sweater and a polo.
Prices $50 to $375; on sale Sunday June 28 at 10 p.m. at the Barclays Center team store.
Liberty's chief brand officer said landing a brand like NYON 'was always a goal'.

launches.name: Liberty × M.M.LaFleur: workwear capsule in team color
launches.collab: A women's workwear brand with a multi-year Liberty partnership releases limited styles in the team's official seafoam green and two prints.
launches.audience: Working women who are fans; fan-to-office crossover

fever.note: A non-sports apparel category entering team merchandise.

facts.t: Liberty Capsule is part of M.M.LaFleur's multi-year partnership with the Liberty; limited styles in Seafoam Green (the team's official color), a vintage-map 'Borough Print' and an 'Icon Print'.
Pieces shown include a double-breasted blazer, knit jardigan, culottes, tees and a vegan leather jacket.

gaps: No prices, dates or fabric compositions on the page.
Only the brand's own page was read.

launches.name: Liberty's year-round merch operation (profile)
launches.collab: Team-designed mascot products, themed-night shirts with local designers (since 2023), plus Fanatics (store co-operator), Away (luggage), Nike, Homage and NYON as partners.
launches.release_model: 12-month merchandise calendar; first holiday products planned

fever.note: A published account of a peer team's merchandise operation.

facts.t: The Liberty calls itself 'a 12-month business'; off-season merch is planned, including first holiday and stocking-stuffer products; the Barclays store will be renovated for more SKU capacity.
Lead times quoted: about 48 hours to restock a themed-night tee, up to a year for a plush, about eight months for blind boxes.
Quantities are set by consulting other teams' and leagues' comparables plus internal judgment; storage limits discourage overbuying.

Team-reported, unaudited: team-store sales up more than 80% year over year; collaborations with local designers and brands drove more than 30% of merchandise sales; 2026 Pride Night shirt at 100% sell-through.

gaps: Sales figures come from the team via one publication, unattributed to a named speaker; not used to rate any finding.
No prices in the article.

launches.name: NWSL × Dead Dirt: league-wide knit jerseys
launches.collab: A DC designer who is also a club's creative director makes a shared-template knit jersey for every club, with each club's colors, emblems and area codes.
launches.audience: Fans wanting an all-year, wearable jersey
launches.release_model: League-wide capsule, one template across clubs

fever.note: Shows the 'area-code' device appearing outside the WNBA.

facts.t: Knitwear jerseys with a shared template (short sleeves, V-neck), described as 'soft knitwear that you can wear all year'.
All 16 NWSL teams; designs incorporate area codes and emblems; designer Domo Wells (Washington Spirit creative director) via her brand Dead Dirt — her first league-wide collection.
Sold at nwslshop.com and each club's online store.

gaps: No prices or fabric details.
Single publication read.

launches.name: Pacsun × Angel City FC: four-piece capsule at a mall retailer
launches.collab: A youth fashion retailer that treats sport as a brand pillar sells a club capsule in its own stores and online.
launches.audience: Youth and young adults; Los Angeles
launches.release_model: Capsule inside a fashion retailer's calendar

fever.note: Shows a mainstream fashion retailer, not a sports retailer, selling club product.

facts.t: Four pieces: striped long-sleeve polo jersey, graphic tee, fleece sweatshirt, matching sweatpants; soft neutrals and the club's 'sol rosa'.
Priced $40 to $70; fronted by defender Gisele Thompson; funds support the club's education pillar.
Pacsun's chief merchandising officer says the aim is to 'translate that momentum into fashion rooted in youth self-expression'.

gaps: Market-growth statistics in the article are the publisher's, not Pacsun's, and are not used here.
No sales information.
